verbs.name: pull
verbs.description: Fetch, check out the base branch and fast-forward it; refuses on a dirty tree.

repo.description: Manifest slug. Omit to resolve from the cwd's origin URL hash. Needed because the Kiro workspace is multi-root and the cwd is usually 00workdir.

verdict.description: PASS, FAIL, HUMAN or RUNNING; always the first key

head.description: one-line log of the new HEAD

verbs.name: branch-start
verbs.description: Create or check out the ticket branch from the manifest pattern, off the fetched base branch.

title.description: Plan title, slugged into the branch name

repo.description: Manifest slug. Omit to resolve from the cwd's origin URL hash. Needed because the Kiro workspace is multi-root and the cwd is usually 00workdir.

verdict.description: PASS, FAIL, HUMAN or RUNNING; always the first key

validator.pass_when: exit 0 and HEAD is on branch_name

verbs.name: push
verbs.description: Push the current branch with upstream set; a non-fast-forward returns verdict HUMAN with the exact force command and does nothing.

repo.description: Manifest slug. Omit to resolve from the cwd's origin URL hash. Needed because the Kiro workspace is multi-root and the cwd is usually 00workdir.

force_with_lease.description: Only with recorded human approval; refreshes the lease with a fetch first

verdict.description: PASS, FAIL, HUMAN or RUNNING; always the first key

mr_create_url.description: new-MR link printed by GitLab, when present

validator.pass_when: exit 0; exit 2 with VERDICT: HUMAN on non-fast-forward

pull.note: Class is write because it changes the local checkout; no remote effect. default branch already comes from the manifest today.

branch-start.note: Branch name is derived, never typed: already true today. Keep the dirty-tree refusal and the existing-branch checkout path.

push.note: Human-only in the target design: the agent is denied git push. CLI --force today skips the approval check that the at do path enforces; the verb must not.
